chapterTitle: Chapter 9 Alkynes: An Introduction to Organic Synthesis
title: Problem 9-12

pages.text: PROBLEM 9-12 Beginning with 4-octyne as your only source of carbon, and using any inorganic reagents necessary, how would you synthesize the following compounds? (a) cis-4-Octene (b) Butanal (c) 4-Bromooctane (d) 4-Octanol (e) 4,5-Dichlorooctane (f) Butanoic acid
